svg.title: Model stack and the honest status of each component
svg.desc: Three columns. The deployed engine ships an XGBoost scorer, TreeSHAP attributions, interpretable stage rules and a tamper-evident ledger. The evaluation side holds the TGN encoder, the GRAFT causal transformer, the uncertainty and OOD heads, the k-step forecast head (a ranking result whose target is 93–96 % identical to the nowcast target), the rank-mean fusion that produces the published headline - which does not run in the engine - and the reference baselines. The RSSM world model is a negative result: it failed the M7.7 hard gate and does not ship.
svg.text: Figure 2 — Model stack: what each component is, and what it is honestly worth

g.text: SHIPS IN THE DEPLOYED ENGINE
XGBoost scorer on the 30 named features
engine/train_engine.py → engine/predict.py
A single XGBoost model; two variants by input format (PCAP / CSV).
§4's XGBoost row, test AUROC 0.872, is the harness fit of it.
TreeSHAP attributions
engine/explain.py
Exact, in named-feature space: distinct_dst_ips, payload_hist_0.
Never an embedding index — the PS rules out black-box output.
Stage rules → ATT&CK technique
configs/data.yaml stage_rules · engine/technique_map.yaml
Interpretable thresholds, not a trained 7-class head.
Uncalibrated: stage accuracy is TBD, and says so.
Tamper-evident ledger
ledger/ledger.py · ledger/merkle.py · ledger/verify_cli.py
Hash chain + per-batch Merkle root + anchored checkpoint.
Refuses to write if the weight digest does not match.
EVALUATION-SIDE ONLY — MEASURED, NOT DEPLOYED
TGN temporal-graph encoder
models/tgn.py
Memory over the anonymised host graph; edges stamped at flow end.
Test AUROC 0.840.
GRAFT causal transformer
models/graft.py
Causal + padding mask, pinned bit-identically against future leakage.
Test AUROC 0.701 in the shipped config — below XGBoost.
Evidential + OOD heads
models/losses.py (heads defined in models/graft.py)
Dirichlet uncertainty K/S and a benign-only reconstruction signal.
The engine does not read either — no alert depends on them.
k-step forecast head
eval/forecast.py
Labels shifted by k: a verified RANKING result at k = 4 and k = 8.
Caveat: that target is 93–96 % identical to the NOWCAST target.
Fires 0/2 episodes at the 1 % FPR budget — no forward operating point.
Rank-mean fusion (TGN + XGBoost)
eval/fused.py
Test AUROC 0.933 — published headline; does not run in the engine.
Rank transform is transductive: this operating point is not online.
Reference baselines
models/baselines.py
LSTM test AUROC 0.764.
Logistic regression (the graded baseline) test AUROC 0.573.
NEGATIVE RESULT — DOES NOT SHIP
RSSM world model
models/rssm.py · configs/train_rssm_v2.yaml
Failed the M7.7 hard gate. Twice.
· Posterior collapses; the ensemble band does not widen with horizon.
· 0/2 episodes and 0 s lead at every horizon, v1 and v2 alike.
· Worse than every baseline — and worse than its own input
embeddings, so it destroys signal rather than adding forecasting.
The anti-collapse recipe that recovered most of the ranking gap
(KL warm-up, free bits, reweighted dynamics) is recorded in
docs/decisions/004-m7-hard-gate.md
as the honest starting point for a GPU run — not as a component.
Never tagged, never shipped, never in the pitch.
Its RANKING signal lives in the encoder instead (Figure 1, lane B).
Every AUROC above is the test-split row of the model-comparison table in docs/architecture.md §4 (day-wise splits, 1 % FPR budget, enforced training determinism).
tests/test_figures.py binds each AUROC to the model it describes, each disclosure above to docs/limitations.md, and fails if a figure names a module that does not exist.
